questions.stem:

Assertion – Osmotic pressure is a colligative property.
Reason – Osmotic pressure is directly proportional to molarity at a given temperature.

options.label: A
options.text: Both assertion and reason are true and the reason is the correct explaination of assertion.

options.label: B
options.text: Both assertion and reason are true but the reason is not the correct explaination of assertion.

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion is correct but reason is wrong.

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion is wrong but reason is correct.
